Subject: Request: IR playbook + evidence index for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this — FinBridge is running a SIG/CAIQ compliance mapping next week and our audit team needs a short-form Incident Response (IR) playbook plus an evidence inventory that ties to the SIG control IDs. Specifically we need: 1) the current IR playbook (PDF or docx), 2) a mapped evidence index (spreadsheet) showing where logs/artifacts live for each control, and 3) a brief statement of our retention/forensics policy for event data.

Could you provide these by EOD Friday (11/13)? We only need the high-level artifacts — we can request full logs if the audit team escalates. Also let us know if any items are redacted or have third-party ownership constraints.

Best,
Alice
Alice Brown
Senior InfoSec Manager — FinBridge

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick note on scope so you can plan: the IR playbook we'll share is our customer-facing Incident Response Plan v3 (annotated with playbook owner and RTOs). The evidence index will be a spreadsheet mapping SIG sections to artifact locations (S3 paths, Drive folders, and internal ticket IDs).

Two clarifications before we finalize:
- Do you want full retention timestamps included in the index (creation + deletion dates) or just the current retention policy reference?
- For any logs that live with cloud vendors (e.g., managed logging in cloud provider), we will flag them as third-party-owned and include contact/process notes.

We will attach: redwood_irp_v3.pdf, sig_evidence_index.xlsx, and a redacted forensic log snippet as a sample. If the auditor wants more detail we can provision a secure share.

I will follow up with Ben for the forensic snippet and Karthik for a short statement on retention.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart

Hi Alice —

Quick retention/forensics statement to include in the index:
- Retention: System logs (ingestion) retained 90 days hot, archived 2 years; metadata and audit trails retained 7 years.
- Forensics: We capture immutable snapshots of affected instances and preserve key telemetry (flow logs, process dumps) for 72 hours during a triage window; preservation can be extended on legitimate audit requests.
- Third-party data: Managed services (cloud provider logs, marketplace integrations) are marked as third-party in the index and include owner contact + expected SLA for retrieval.

If you need these as a signed PDF attestation (for SIG), say the word and Evelyn / I will sign and timestamp it.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

1) Please provide a one-page signed attestation that the retention/forensics statement is accurate as of 11/13/2026 (PDF).
2) Schedule a 30-minute call next week (suggested window Mon/Tue AM PST) for the auditor to ask clarifying questions about third-party evidence retrieval.

Also — can you confirm whether any artifacts in the index are subject to export controls or contractual restrictions that would prevent sharing with our external auditors? If so, list those items and the restriction type.

If you can send the attestation by EOD Monday 11/16 and propose two call slots, we should be set.

Best,
Alice
